title: IPv4 CIDR Calculator
description: Parses an IPv4 address with an optional CIDR prefix, a separate prefix, or a dotted netmask, and returns the network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, usable host range, host count, and 32-bit integer form. Set contains to another IPv4 address to test whether that host falls inside the network (a CIDR suffix on contains is ignored). /31 and /32 treat every address as a usable host (RFC 3021). Invalid input returns {valid:false, error, message}. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Leading-zero octets are rejected.

address.description: IPv4 dotted quad, optionally with a /prefix (for example 192.168.1.5/24). Do not pass this together with integer.

integer.description: IPv4 address as an integer from 0 to 2**32-1, used instead of address.

prefix.description: Prefix length 0-32. Must agree with a CIDR suffix or mask when more than one is given. Defaults to 32.

mask.description: Contiguous dotted-decimal netmask such as 255.255.255.0. Non-contiguous masks are rejected.

contains.description: IPv4 address to test for membership. A CIDR suffix on this value is ignored; the host address is what is tested.
